_comment: Forum wallet-login wire contract between warren-connect (the DiscourseConnect broker) and every Warren client, frozen at v1: the X-Warren signing inputs and the exact signed request bytes for a login and for an in-app report, plus the provider's canonical answer per outcome. Synthetic host, key and secret only. The signing rule itself (canonical message, SS58 address) is pinned by identity.json; this file pins what rides on it for the forum routes. Adding a request name here breaks the consumers until they handle it, on purpose.

signer._comment: signing_key_hex is the raw 32-byte Ed25519 secret (SigningKey::from_bytes), not a wallet seed: identity.json pins the seed-to-key derivation. timestamp is the X-Warren-Timestamp value; the provider accepts it within 60 seconds of its own clock, so these exact bytes replayed through a live provider land on the clock_skew answer, and their acceptance is proven by verifying with the provider clock set to timestamp. connect_host is not signed (only the path is) and stands in for the deployment's connect host.

requests.name: login
requests._comment: Approval of a browser sign-in session: the body is the sid the deep link carried, serialised as exactly these bytes.

requests.name: report_with_log
requests._comment: In-app bug report with a gzipped redacted problem report. fields is what the app assembled; the body is that object plus log_gz_b64 (standard base64 of log_gz_hex), serialised compact with keys in ascending order, and the signed bytes are the sent bytes. log_gz_hex inflates to log_utf8, whose System information header the provider parses for the public note.

responses._comment: Status, Content-Type and exact body bytes the provider answers per outcome. Clients match clock_skew and invalid_report as body tokens and every other refusal by status; the JSON bodies carry their keys in ascending order. The answers naming a handle, a slot or a topic were produced under the provider parameters below; a provider replaying them substitutes its own forum origin in topic_url.

subscription_required.body_utf8: forum access requires a Warren subscription
forum access requires a Warren subscription

provider._comment: The synthetic deployment parameters the identity-bearing answers were produced under. handle is HMAC-SHA256(handle_secret, pubkey) rendered as three proquints (the broker's keyed derivation, which a client never computes) and external_id the full tag; notify_slot is the digest slot drawn for this wallet in that run (a live provider draws at random); topic_id is the id the forum minted; forum_public_url is the forum origin of that deployment.
